name: skull-king-score-keeper
description: A pirate-themed score keeper for the Skull King card game

scripts.build:copy: mkdir -p build/runFiles && cp index.html styles.css manifest.json sw.js build/runFiles/ && cp favicon.ico icon-16.png icon-32.png icon-192.png icon-512.png apple-touch-icon.png icon.svg skull_logo.png build/runFiles/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.build: rm -rf build/runFiles && npm run build:tsc && npm run build:copy
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build
